lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
Listen needs to before the thing.

data.right: I listen to music every day.
data.why: Listen needs to before the thing.
data.memory: I listen to music every day.

native.hook: 「音楽を聞く」で to が消えてる
native.tip: listen は「listen to ～」の形。to を忘れずに！
native.caption: “I listen music every day.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「音楽を聞く」には「を」しかないので、to が抜けがち。listen のあとは to が必要です。 “I listen to music every day.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“to”。listen のあとは to。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Listen always needs to before the thing you hear.
en.caption: Do you say “I listen music every day.”? 😅 Japanese uses wo only, so to gets lost. English needs listen to. The natural way is “I listen to music every day.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
